subject: SUM clause
notes: kb/Work PB482. BOTH halves of the sentence are now implemented and screened, and neither was before. (a) 'a numeric data item' - ResolveSumAddend refuses a group item and every non-numeric category under COBOL2045, and the same arm refuses every REFERENCE-MODIFIED spelling, because 8.4.3.3.4 GR6 c) makes the unique data item a ref-mod creates class and category alphanumeric unless the usage is national, so no ref-modded operand can be the numeric item SR5 requires. (b) 'not defined in the report section' - the arm choice runs against the report-section-exclusive name set shared with 13.18.16.3 SR2 and 13.15.3 SR16, so a report-section addend is SR4's data-name-1 and stages loud (rolled totals, GR6) instead of failing resolution under the wrong rule. Positively, identifier-1 is 8.4.3.1.2 Format 2's qualified-data-name-with-subscripts: the addend is captured as the WRITTEN reference and bound in the procedure phase through the one ExpressionBinder, so a literal, index-name or arithmetic subscript resolves through the ordinary subscript machinery. Measured before the fix on 359a2ebc: SUM WS-CELL(2) compiled and then ABORTED at the first GENERATE (NotImplementedCobolFeatureException 'SUM addend not resolvable to storage'), SUM WS-TXT(1:2) silently summed the whole item, and SUM WS-TXT over a PIC X(6) holding '123456' printed 6912. The golden's three subscript spellings each total 066 over three GENERATEs, derived from GR7 c) 1) and GR3.
